/*********************************************************************/
/* Includes                                                          */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/ipc.h>
#include <sys/types.h>

#pragma datamodel(P128)      /* @B1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Constants                                                         */
/*********************************************************************/

/* Shared memory operation flags */
#define SHM_RDONLY           0X00001000 /* Attach read-only */
#define SHM_RND              0X00002000 /* Round attach address to SHMLBA */
#define SHM_DEST             0X00000400 /* Not used */
#define SHM_TS_NP            0x00010000 /* Create teraspace segment @A1A*/
#define SHM_RESIZE_NP        0x00040000 /* Allow resizeable teraspace
                                           segments @A1A*/
#define SHM_MAP_FIXED_NP     0x00100000 /* Attach teraspace segment at same
                                           address in all processes @A1A*/

/* Values */
#define SHMLBA             (0x10000000) /* Segment low boundary address
                                           multiple */

/* Command definitions for shmctl() and/or shmctl64() */
#define SHM_SIZE  6  /* Command: Resize shared memory segment.   @A2A*/
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 550)                                 /* @B4A*/
  #if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) /* @B4A*/
    /* Command: Set shared memory segment page size.             @B4A*/
    #define SHM_PAGESIZE  200                                 /* @B4A*/
  #endif                                                      /* @B4A*/
#endif                                                        /* @B4A*/

/* Possible shared memory page size values */
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 550)                                 /* @B4A*/
  #if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) /* @B4A*/
    #define SHM_4KB_PAGESIZE             4096                 /* @B4A*/
    #define SHM_64KB_PAGESIZE           65536                 /* @B4A*/
  #endif                                                      /* @B4A*/
#endif                                                        /* @B4A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Typedefs                                                          */
/*********************************************************************/
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 550)                                 /* @B3A*/
  typedef unsigned int  shmatt_t;                             /* @B3A*/
#endif                                                        /* @B3A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

/* Basic shared memory segment information */
typedef struct shmid_ds {
  struct ipc_perm shm_perm;   /* Permissions */
  size_t          shm_segsz;  /* Size of segment in bytes @B2C*/
  pid_t           shm_lpid;   /* Process ID of last shared memory operation */
  pid_t           shm_cpid;   /* Process ID of creator */
  int             shm_nattch; /* Number of current attaches */
  time_t          shm_atime;  /* Time of last shmat() */
  time_t          shm_dtime;  /* Time of last shmdt() */
  time_t          shm_ctime;  /* Time of last change by shmctl() */
} shmtablentry_t;

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 550)                                 /* @B3A*/
  #if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) /* @B3A*/
  /* Extended (64-Bit Enabled) shared memory segment information @B3A*/
    typedef struct shmid_ds64 {                               /* @B3A*/
    #if ((defined _64_BIT_TIME) && (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 720))/* @B5A*/
      struct ipc_perm  shm_perm;   /* Permissions                @B5A*/
      pid_t            shm_lpid;   /* Process ID of last shared
                                      memory operation           @B5A*/
      pid_t            shm_cpid;   /* Process ID of creator      @B5A*/
      shmatt_t         shm_nattch; /* Number of current attaches @B5A*/
      size64_t         shm_segsz;  /* Size of segment in bytes   @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_atime;  /* Time of last shmat()       @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_dtime;  /* Time of last shmdt()       @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_ctime;  /* Time of last change by
                                      shmctl()                   @B5A*/
      psize_t          shm_pagesize; /* Page size                @B5A*/
      char             shm_reserved4[24]; /* Reserved space      @B5A*/
    #else                                                     /* @B5A*/
      struct ipc_perm  shm_perm;   /* Permissions                @B3A*/
      pid_t            shm_lpid;   /* Process ID of last shared
                                      memory operation           @B3A*/
      pid_t            shm_cpid;   /* Process ID of creator      @B3A*/
      shmatt_t         shm_nattch; /* Number of current attaches @B3A*/
      size64_t         shm_segsz;  /* Size of segment in bytes   @B3A*/
      char             shm_reserved1[4]; /* Reserved space       @B3A*/
      time_t           shm_atime;  /* Time of last shmat()       @B3A*/
      char             shm_reserved2[4]; /* Reserved space       @B3A*/
      time_t           shm_dtime;  /* Time of last shmdt()       @B3A*/
      char             shm_reserved3[4]; /* Reserved space       @B3A*/
      time_t           shm_ctime;  /* Time of last change by
                                      shmctl()                   @B3A*/
      psize_t          shm_pagesize; /* Page size                @B4A*/
      char             shm_reserved4[24]; /* Reserved space      @B4C*/
    #endif                                                    /* @B5A*/
    } shmtablentry64_t;                                       /* @B3A*/

    #if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 720)                             /* @B5A*/
    typedef struct shmid_ds64_time64 {                        /* @B5A*/
      struct ipc_perm  shm_perm;   /* Permissions                @B5A*/
      pid_t            shm_lpid;   /* Process ID of last shared
                                      memory operation           @B5A*/
      pid_t            shm_cpid;   /* Process ID of creator      @B5A*/
      shmatt_t         shm_nattch; /* Number of current attaches @B5A*/
      size64_t         shm_segsz;  /* Size of segment in bytes   @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_atime;  /* Time of last shmat()       @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_dtime;  /* Time of last shmdt()       @B5A*/
      time64_t         shm_ctime;  /* Time of last change by
                                      shmctl()                   @B5A*/
      psize_t          shm_pagesize; /* Page size                @B5A*/
      char             shm_reserved4[24]; /* Reserved space      @B5A*/
    } shmtablentry64_time64_t;                                /* @B5A*/
    #endif                                                    /* @B5A*/
  #endif                                                      /* @B3A*/
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/* Function Prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN
    #ifdef __ILEC400__
         #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else
         #define QBFC_EXTERN extern "C"
    #endif

    #define __QBFC_EXTERN
#endif

QBFC_EXTERN void *shmat(int shmid, const void *shmaddr, int shmflg);
QBFC_EXTERN int   shmctl(int shmid, int cmd, struct shmid_ds *buf);
QBFC_EXTERN int   shmdt(const void *shmaddr);
QBFC_EXTERN int   shmget(key_t key, size_t size, int shmflg);
QBFC_EXTERN int   qp0zShmgetTs(key_t key, size_t size, int shmflg); /* @A1A*/

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=550)                                         /* @B3A*/
  #if ((!defined(_POSIX_SOURCE)) && (!defined(_POSIX1_SOURCE)))     /* @B3A*/
    QBFC_EXTERN int shmctl64(int shmid, int cmd, struct shmid_ds64 *buf);
                                                                    /* @B3A*/
    QBFC_EXTERN int shmget64(key_t key, size64_t size, int shmflg); /* @B3A*/
  #endif                                                            /* @B3A*/
#endif                                                              /* @B3A*/

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720)                                         /* @B5A*/
  #if ((!defined(_POSIX_SOURCE)) && (!defined(_POSIX1_SOURCE)))     /* @B5A*/
    QBFC_EXTERN int shmctl64_time64(int shmid, int cmd,
                 struct shmid_ds64_time64 *buf);                    /* @B5A*/
    #ifdef _64_BIT_TIME                                             /* @B5A*/
      #pragma map(shmctl64, "shmctl64_time64")                      /* @B5A*/
    #endif                                                          /* @B5A*/
  #endif                                                            /* @B5A*/
#endif                                                              /* @B5A*/

#if defined(__TERASPACE__)
  #if !defined(__TS_SHM_NO_MAP)
    #pragma map(shmget, "qp0zShmgetTs")
  #endif
#endif /* @A1A*/

#pragma datamodel(pop)       /* @B1A*/
